Inclusion Criteria:

       -  Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Diminished mental capacity

  -  Tobramycin allergy
  -  Patient history requiring IV administration of vancomycin  [OR] or tobramycin perioperatively
  -  Chronic kidney disease stage III and stage IV
